name: generateMachineActivityArchive
description: ⚠️ ADMIN OPERATION ⚠️ Generates a machine activity archive for a given machine ID. This creates server load and should be used sparingly. Corresponds to POST /machines/archive/{machineID}. Requires the `machines:write` API key scope. Returns a job `id`; pass it as jobId to retrieveMachineActivityArchive. [ADMIN]

machineId.description: The ID of the machine to generate archive for
